Mt. Terrat tunnel

raw: [name="Big Bob"]   We'll be safe after we enter this tunnel. At the other end of this tunnel is Mt. Mortica, which won't have very many bounty hunters.
speaker: Big Bob
content: We'll be safe after we enter this tunnel. At the other end of this tunnel is Mt. Mortica, which won't have very many bounty hunters.

raw: [name="Big Bob"]   As for that Skadi... I used to scoff at those rumors that described her as a living avalanche. Turns out, I learned the truth today.
speaker: Big Bob
content: As for that Skadi... I used to scoff at those rumors that described her as a living avalanche. Turns out, I learned the truth today.

raw: [name="Big Bob"]   I was expecting her to be a bit stronger than your average shmuck, but those rumors turned out to not be exaggerated after all.
speaker: Big Bob
content: I was expecting her to be a bit stronger than your average shmuck, but those rumors turned out to not be exaggerated after all.

raw: [name="Big Bob"]   No wonder why the guys at the bar always looked at me like I'm crazy when I laughed at them for being terrified of her.
speaker: Big Bob
content: No wonder why the guys at the bar always looked at me like I'm crazy when I laughed at them for being terrified of her.

raw: [name="Big Bob"]   Now it's my turn to be terrified, hah.
speaker: Big Bob
content: Now it's my turn to be terrified, hah.

raw: [name="Grani"]   It's true! I heard those same rumors going around in Rhodes Island too.
speaker: Grani
content: It's true! I heard those same rumors going around in Rhodes Island too.

raw: [name="Grani"]   I've also never been sent on a mission with her before. I knew that she was really powerful, but I never expected this to happen...
speaker: Grani
content: I've also never been sent on a mission with her before. I knew that she was really powerful, but I never expected this to happen...

raw: [name="Grani"]   I didn't even know that she was a bounty hunter before.
speaker: Grani
content: I didn't even know that she was a bounty hunter before.

raw: [name="Big Bob"]   She's one of the most infamous bounty hunters out there.
speaker: Big Bob
content: She's one of the most infamous bounty hunters out there.

raw: [name="Big Bob"]   Now that she's also after the treasure, we're going to have our work cut out for us.
speaker: Big Bob
content: Now that she's also after the treasure, we're going to have our work cut out for us.

raw: [name="Big Bob"]   I have no idea if the two of us will be able to beat her to it.
speaker: Big Bob
content: I have no idea if the two of us will be able to beat her to it.

raw: [name="Carol"]   If that's the case, does that mean my village...
speaker: Carol
content: If that's the case, does that mean my village...

raw: [name="Big Bob"]   Don't worry. I think she'll drive the rest of the bounty hunters away.
speaker: Big Bob
content: Don't worry. I think she'll drive the rest of the bounty hunters away.

raw: [name="Big Bob"]   Though... she might destroy a few villages in the process.
speaker: Big Bob
content: Though... she might destroy a few villages in the process.

speaker: Carol
content: Ugh...

raw: [name="Grani"]   I don't think she's here for the treasure. I can't let something like that happen.
speaker: Grani
content: I don't think she's here for the treasure. I can't let something like that happen.

raw: [name="Big Bob"]   So, your Rhodes Island or whatever, will hire just about anyone?
speaker: Big Bob
content: So, your Rhodes Island or whatever, will hire just about anyone?

raw: [name="Grani"]   No Rhodes Island operator would ever harm others recklessly for their own selfish gain.
speaker: Grani
content: No Rhodes Island operator would ever harm others recklessly for their own selfish gain.

raw: [name="Big Bob"]   Hmph. Well, you seem nice enough, and even did me a favor. However, the fact that your Rhodes Island is enabling Skadi, an entity who knows only destruction, makes me question whether your organization truly seeks to help the Infected.
speaker: Big Bob
content: Hmph. Well, you seem nice enough, and even did me a favor. However, the fact that your Rhodes Island is enabling Skadi, an entity who knows only destruction, makes me question whether your organization truly seeks to help the Infected.

raw: [name="Big Bob"]   Furthermore, as someone stricken with Oripathy, I've never seen Rhodes Island do anything to help those like me. We're still abused wherever we go.
speaker: Big Bob
content: Furthermore, as someone stricken with Oripathy, I've never seen Rhodes Island do anything to help those like me. We're still abused wherever we go.

speaker: Grani
content: Big Bob...

raw: [name="Big Bob"]   What, got nothing to say to that? Honestly, I have no idea why you have so much faith in an organization like that.
speaker: Big Bob
content: What, got nothing to say to that? Honestly, I have no idea why you have so much faith in an organization like that.

raw: [name="Big Bob"]   As far as I can tell, their claim of wanting to help the Infected is just lip service. In the end, all they see is money.
speaker: Big Bob
content: As far as I can tell, their claim of wanting to help the Infected is just lip service. In the end, all they see is money.

raw: [name="Big Bob"]   Hmph, what's the deal with Rhodes Island anyway? In this world, there's nothing that speaks louder than the coins in my hand!
speaker: Big Bob
content: Hmph, what's the deal with Rhodes Island anyway? In this world, there's nothing that speaks louder than the coins in my hand!

speaker: Grani
content: Sorry...

raw: [name="Big Bob"]   What are you apologizing for? You're still a kid, and you still can't tell between ideals and reality, nor do you know your worth. But all of this is perfectly normal.
speaker: Big Bob
content: What are you apologizing for? You're still a kid, and you still can't tell between ideals and reality, nor do you know your worth. But all of this is perfectly normal.

raw: [name="Grani"]   No, that's not what I meant. I know that I'm still lacking.
speaker: Grani
content: No, that's not what I meant. I know that I'm still lacking.

raw: [name="Grani"]   It's just that... whether as a police officer, or as an operator, I've met a lot of Infected.
speaker: Grani
content: It's just that... whether as a police officer, or as an operator, I've met a lot of Infected.

raw: [name="Grani"]   ...I wasn't able to save them all, because I was lacking.
speaker: Grani
content: ...I wasn't able to save them all, because I was lacking.

speaker: Grani
content: Rhodes Island is the same.

raw: [name="Big Bob"]   In other words, they're useless? Hah!
speaker: Big Bob
content: In other words, they're useless? Hah!

raw: [name="Big Bob"]   That's right. When the Infected were slaving away underground, locked away in remote places, or being killed for no reason, where was Rhodes Island?
speaker: Big Bob
content: That's right. When the Infected were slaving away underground, locked away in remote places, or being killed for no reason, where was Rhodes Island?

raw: [name="Grani"]   Even when we try our hardest, we sometimes still come up short. That's true for both me and for Rhodes Island.
speaker: Grani
content: Even when we try our hardest, we sometimes still come up short. That's true for both me and for Rhodes Island.

raw: [name="Grani"]   Despite that, I'll never give up on any innocent Infected who I see.
speaker: Grani
content: Despite that, I'll never give up on any innocent Infected who I see.

speaker: Grani
content: Rhodes Island is the same.

speaker: Big Bob
content: Tch.

speaker: Grani
content: Sorry, Big Bob...

raw: [name="Big Bob"]  ...I told you, you're just a kid. What good does it do to hammer you with my grievances?
speaker: Big Bob
content: ...I told you, you're just a kid. What good does it do to hammer you with my grievances?

raw: [name="Big Bob"]  But that Skadi, your coworker, would not hesitate to point her weapon at you, or abduct Carol to seize the treasure.
speaker: Big Bob
content: But that Skadi, your coworker, would not hesitate to point her weapon at you, or abduct Carol to seize the treasure.

raw: [name="Big Bob"]  Can you say with confidence that someone like that would share your ideals and work with you to help the Infected?
speaker: Big Bob
content: Can you say with confidence that someone like that would share your ideals and work with you to help the Infected?

raw: [name="Grani"]   I don't know what Skadi plans on doing, so I can't answer that.
speaker: Grani
content: I don't know what Skadi plans on doing, so I can't answer that.

raw: [name="Grani"]   However, I trust that if Rhodes Island took her in, then she must have her reasons.
speaker: Grani
content: However, I trust that if Rhodes Island took her in, then she must have her reasons.

raw: [name="Big Bob"]   You can forget my rambling then. I overstepped my bounds.
speaker: Big Bob
content: You can forget my rambling then. I overstepped my bounds.

speaker: Grani
content: It's okay.

raw: [name="Grani"]   Anyway, our priority right now is to help Miss Carol find the treasure.
speaker: Grani
content: Anyway, our priority right now is to help Miss Carol find the treasure.

raw: [name="Big Bob"]   I'm just dead weight now, with this injured leg. Heh, I never thought I'd be the one burdening two little girls.
speaker: Big Bob
content: I'm just dead weight now, with this injured leg. Heh, I never thought I'd be the one burdening two little girls.

raw: [name="Grani"]   Big Bob, we'll only consider you a burden on one condition...
speaker: Grani
content: Big Bob, we'll only consider you a burden on one condition...

raw: [name="Grani"]   ...and that's if you don't plan on sharing the treasure with us.
speaker: Grani
content: ...and that's if you don't plan on sharing the treasure with us.

speaker: Big Bob
content: Oh? Hahaha!

raw: [name="Carol"]   Mister Bob, I wasn't disgusted by your condition. It's just that... I was a bit scared.
speaker: Carol
content: Mister Bob, I wasn't disgusted by your condition. It's just that... I was a bit scared.

raw: [name="Carol"]   I'm from the sticks, and I haven't seen many Infected people. But even I can tell... that you've endured a lot of hardship.
speaker: Carol
content: I'm from the sticks, and I haven't seen many Infected people. But even I can tell... that you've endured a lot of hardship.

raw: [name="Carol"]   I apologize if I was rude to you before.
speaker: Carol
content: I apologize if I was rude to you before.

raw: [name="Big Bob"]   Don't worry about it. Heh, as long as we find the treasure and you get me my share, I'll be a happy camper.
speaker: Big Bob
content: Don't worry about it. Heh, as long as we find the treasure and you get me my share, I'll be a happy camper.

raw: [name="Carol"]   Mhm... The treasure is important to our village, but we only need enough to resolve our problems. Mister Bob, you'll be able to get your fair share.
speaker: Carol
content: Mhm... The treasure is important to our village, but we only need enough to resolve our problems. Mister Bob, you'll be able to get your fair share.

raw: [name="Carol"]   That's why Grani and I need help, and will aid you as well.
speaker: Carol
content: That's why Grani and I need help, and will aid you as well.

speaker: Carol
content: Right, Grani?

raw: [name="Grani"]   Of course. In any case, we need to get moving soon.
speaker: Grani
content: Of course. In any case, we need to get moving soon.

raw: [name="Big Bob"]   Our next destination should be Mt. Mortica. That mountain was named after some knight who died long ago.
speaker: Big Bob
content: Our next destination should be Mt. Mortica. That mountain was named after some knight who died long ago.

raw: [name="Big Bob"]   If my intuition is correct, then that should be where the treasure is located, right?
speaker: Big Bob
content: If my intuition is correct, then that should be where the treasure is located, right?

raw: [name="Carol"]   However, there are a lot of caves up ahead. It'd take an average person weeks to search them all.
speaker: Carol
content: However, there are a lot of caves up ahead. It'd take an average person weeks to search them all.

raw: [name="Big Bob"]   Of course. That's why we can't do this without you. There's no way we're going to hand you to that red-eyed woman.
speaker: Big Bob
content: Of course. That's why we can't do this without you. There's no way we're going to hand you to that red-eyed woman.

speaker: Carol
content: Please lead the way then.

speaker: Big Bob
content: Sounds like a plan.

speaker: Big Bob
content: Wait a moment.

raw: [name="Big Bob"]   There's some movement near the tunnel's exit...
speaker: Big Bob
content: There's some movement near the tunnel's exit...
Aaaagh—

content: Someone... help... save me...

speaker: 'Captain'
content: It's... the Infected...

content: Big Bob, what are you doing?

content: These guys aren't your ordinary...
